fields.summary: An employee in registration opened the records of 14 patients with no treatment or business relationship. The audit log shows the access over three weeks.

factors.finding: Demographics, diagnoses and visit dates for 14 patients. Directly identifying; no financial account numbers.
A workforce member who is bound by the hospital's confidentiality policy and who has no known tie to the patients.
The audit log shows the records were opened and scrolled. No export or print is recorded.
Access removed; the employee attested in writing that nothing was copied or shared. Not independently verified.

fields.conclusion: Low probability of compromise not demonstrated: treat as a breach and notify

clocks.label: Internal target for letters in the mail
Report to the federal regulator, fewer than 500 individuals (within 60 days after the end of the calendar year)
